Name: CAMERA_FADE_PARAM_ST
Description:
Camera fade: models close to the camera fade out (dithered) so they don't block the view. Picked by ChrModelParam's Camera Fade Param ID for characters (-1 uses the model material's own fade ID, 0 none); row 0 can't be used. Distances are from the camera to the model, in metres. As the camera closes in: fully opaque beyond Far Fade: Start Distance, fading to Semi-Transparent Alpha by Far Fade: Semi-Transparent Distance, held there until Near Fade: Start Distance, then fading to invisible at Near Fade: Invisible Distance.
Lives in systemparam.parambnd, not regulation.bin, and is read once at startup. Retail: 1 and 2 semi-transparent tall and short parts, 100 player, 101 human-sized characters, 110 medium, 120 large characters.

Fields.Name: Near Fade: Invisible Distance
Fields.Description: Camera distance (m) at or below which the model is fully invisible. Alpha falls from Semi-Transparent Alpha at Near Fade: Start Distance to 0 here (the ramp is at least 0.01 m wide).

Fields.Name: Near Fade: Start Distance
Fields.Description: Camera distance (m) where the near fade starts: alpha falls from Semi-Transparent Alpha here to 0 at Near Fade: Invisible Distance.

Fields.Name: Far Fade: Semi-Transparent Distance
Fields.Description: Camera distance (m) where the far fade ends: the model reaches Semi-Transparent Alpha here and stays at it until Near Fade: Start Distance.

Fields.Name: Far Fade: Start Distance
Fields.Description: Camera distance (m) where fading begins. Beyond it the model is fully opaque and the fade is skipped; alpha falls from 1 here to Semi-Transparent Alpha at Far Fade: Semi-Transparent Distance (the ramp is at least 0.01 m wide).

Fields.Name: Semi-Transparent Alpha
Fields.Description: Opacity (0-1) between the far and near fades. 1 = no far fade, only the near fade to invisible (retail player row 100).
